title: Product Manager, Sales-Assisted Growth
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Customer Growth & Experience (CGX) team owns the full customer lifecycle - from the moment a customer lands on plaid.com http://plaid.com to their journey across onboarding, activation, adoption, and long-term success.

Within CGX, this role sits at the intersection of Growth and GTM. We own the product experience for sales-worked customers across every segment - onboarding, premium features, upsell and cross-sell, and offboarding - and the internal tooling that makes Plaid's own sales organization faster and more effective at every stage of a deal. We're focused on growing and retaining the accounts sales brings in, and on using AI to meaningfully change how sellers and their accounts get served, not just to speed up existing steps.

As a Product Manager on Sales-Assisted Growth, you'll own the experience for customers who come to Plaid through our sales team - SDRs, AEs, AMs from onboarding through expansion and offboarding: how they get set up, which premium features they unlock, how they discover and adopt new products, and how they're communicated with along the way.

You'll also own the internal tooling that removes manual work for sellers and gives them the right view of their accounts at the right time. Salesforce itself sits with our GTM Technology team; you'll own what sellers use around and on top of it.

You'll be expected to push hard on where AI can meaningfully change how accounts are grown and how sellers work, rather than just digitizing existing steps. You'll draw on propensity and account-health signals from our data science team, and help shape what those models should predict over time.

This is a high-impact IC role with a clear, ownable surface and plenty of room to shape how Plaid approaches customer growth. You’ll sit at the intersection of product and GTM, using account and pipeline insights to uncover expansion opportunities within the existing customer base and help identify where Plaid should invest next.

It’s a unique opportunity to build across account growth, internal tooling, and AI-powered products; all within one role.

Responsibilities

- Own the sales-worked customer experience end to end - onboarding, premium and gated features, in-product upsell and cross-sell, lifecycle communications, and offboarding

- Own the internal tooling that removes manual work for sellers and gives them the right view of their accounts at the right time

- Own external-facing tooling specific to sales-worked accounts (e.g., RFI response tooling, prospect-facing dashboards)

- Consume propensity and account-health signals from BI/DS to drive expansion and retention, with room to shape what those models should predict

- Identify and ship AI-driven automation across the account lifecycle and seller workflow, with a clear point of view on what should be AI-assisted vs. AI-automated vs. human-owned

- Partner with GTM leadership on strategic inputs - where to expand within the existing base, which segments to prioritize

- Partner cross-functionally with Eng, Design, BI/DS, GTM Technology, Lifecycle Marketing, and Sales and Account Management leadership to ship and measure impact

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform - open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.
Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide - including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole - Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.
In March 2026, we closed a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with participation from Alven, ISAI, and Axeleo - backed by founders from Datadog, dbt Labs, and Hugging Face.
The Role
We're looking for an Account Executive based in Germany to drive enterprise sales across the DACH region. You'll own the full sales cycle for Kestra's Enterprise Edition, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close.
This is a fully remote position. Because the role requires regular engagement with German-speaking enterprise buyers, we're hiring specifically from Germany.
What You'll Do

• Own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH region, from outbound prospecting to contract close.

• Build and manage a qualified pipeline through a mix of outbound efforts, inbound leads, and community-sourced opportunities from Kestra's open-source user base.

• Run discovery calls, product demos (in partnership with Solution Engineers), and commercial negotiations with technical and business stakeholders.

• Develop account strategies for target organizations, mapping decision-makers across engineering, data, and IT leadership.

• Collaborate closely with Solution Engineers, Developer Advocates, and Product to align messaging with what Kestra delivers in practice.

What We're Looking For

• Proven track record in B2B enterprise software sales, ideally selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, platform teams, data teams).

• Ability to understand technical products at a level that earns credibility with engineering stakeholders. You don't need to write code, but you need to follow a technical conversation about infrastructure, orchestration, or automation.

• Comfortable operating in a startup environment with minimal structure. You build your own playbook rather than waiting for one.

• Strong communicator who can translate technical capabilities into business value for different audiences.

• Past experience at a B2B SaaS company, especially in an early-stage or growth-stage environment.

• Understanding of land-and-expand sales motions and usage-based pricing models.

What You Get

• Real ownership in a globally distributed, technical team .

• Direct exposure to product strategy and company priorities.

title: Principal Application Software Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

The Application SW team sits within Application Engineering in Product & Delivery. We bridge AI innovation and production vehicles, defining and executing the strategy for integrating Wayve’s autonomy stack into multiple OEM platforms, and working directly with automotive customers, including major Japanese OEMs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As an Application SW Engineer, you’ll be responsible for the bring-up and early validation of our AI software stack on customer hardware platforms, ensuring it performs reliably across diverse SoCs and operating systems. You’ll work closely with Verification, Release and OEM partner teams to make integration smooth and delivery dependable. Your time will be split across platform bring-up and integration, customer and partner engagement, and technical leadership, including helping to build the team.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

- Executing software bring-up on customer hardware platforms (e.g. NVIDIA Drive, Qualcomm Ride).

- Porting and configuring Linux-based systems, QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments.

- Integrating and validating drivers, middleware and boot-time configurations.

- Working with Verification and Release teams to integrate hardware into CI/CD, HIL and test infrastructure.

- Working with OEM and Tier 1 teams to resolve hardware-specific integration issues.

- Implementing system-level diagnostics, logging and secure boot configuration.

- Developing automation for setup, flashing, health checks and test execution on target hardware.

- Defining and executing the strategy for integrating our autonomy stack into multiple OEM platforms.

- Building the team and providing technical leadership across integration work.

 

🙌 You should apply if:

Essential

- 8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience.

- Strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash, and Python.
Deep understanding of Linux-based embedded systems (Yocto, systemd, bootloaders, device trees).

- Familiarity with QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments and the ability to configure and debug them on target hardware.
Experience with bring-up on automotive-grade SoCs (e.g., NVIDIA Orin, Qualcomm SA8295/SA8650, Renesas, TI).

- Comfortable working with hardware debuggers, flashing tools, serial consoles, and board support packages (BSPs).

- Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, Ethernet, PCIe, SPI, I2C.

- Hands-on experience integrating embedded platforms into CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks.

Desirable

- Exposure to automotive verification environments (e.g., HIL systems, Vector toolchains, custom CI rigs).

- Experience working in a safety-critical domain with an understanding of ISO 26262, boot-time determinism, and watchdogs.

- Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates, and system-level cybersecurity topics.

- Familiarity with Docker, Jenkins, Git, and artifact management tools like JFrog Artifactory.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision

title: Senior Manager, CS Data & Analytics

description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

 

The Customer Success Data & Analytics (CSDA) team sets the standards for how data is used across Customer Success, building the foundational data and tooling that help CS deliver a better, more efficient customer experience. With a data engineering team rebuilding the CS data model and an Applied AI & Data Science lead embedded on the team, we’re building what analytics looks like in the AI era.

As Senior Manager, Customer Success & Experience Analytics, you’ll be the analytics partner to CS leadership, shaping how the organization understands its performance and its customers, with a focus on customer experience and enablement. Reporting to the Senior Director of CS Data & Analytics, you’ll lead two analysts and bring a holistic customer view by connecting data across Care, Onboarding, Enablement, and Product.

This role is ideal for a player-coach who is energized by ambiguous problems, works iteratively, and isn’t only one kind of data person. Their home base is analytics, with a real interest in data science and analytics engineering. They don’t need to be an expert in either, just passionate about expanding their knowledge, something AI tools now put within reach for anyone.

This role will work hybrid 2 days / week out of our Boston office. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Run the Customer Success Business Review: Own the tools and mechanisms behind the weekly review, driving rigorous but efficient inspection of key business indicators and hosting insightful discussions with business owners about their successes and challenges.

• Lead Analytics for Customer Experience & Voice of the Customer: Be a major contributor to the CX and VOC programs by owning the analytics behind them: the reporting, insights, and recommendations that help the business improve how customers experience Toast. Go beyond what the numbers say to why they move, making sure we measure and manage the right inputs for the outcomes we care about. Use survey verbatims, contact transcripts, and other unstructured data alongside traditional metrics.

• Measure Education & Enablement Impact: Own the framework connecting training, self-service content, and in-product guidance to ticket reduction, self-service, and adoption. Design test-and-control measurement, set baselines before programs launch, and drive a data-first culture in customer education.

• Lead the Team & Shape the Data Foundation: Grow a team of talented analysts and support the ownership they bring to their areas. Run a transparent intake and prioritization process, and expand self-service through AI tooling and well-documented data. Partner with data engineering on the CS data model rebuild, and bring the Applied AI & Data Science lead well-framed problems worth modeling.

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Experience: 8+ years in analytics, BI, or data science, including 2+ years leading analysts, with a track record of owning a recurring executive business review and turning ambiguous questions into scoped, answerable analyses.

• Hands-on experience extracting insight from unstructured data such as survey verbatims or support transcripts

• Working comfort with statistics and experimental design. You’ve dabbled in data science, such as running a regression to find what drives NPS or a classification model to find themes in text, and you know control groups, matched cohorts, and pre/post baselining. You use these methods for exploratory work and partner with a data scientist on anything production-grade

• Strong SQL, fluency with a modern data stack (Snowflake, Hex, dbt, or equivalent), and a clear point of view on data visualization and what makes a dashboard or analytical artifact useful

• A tinkerer and builder with hands-on experience

title: Associate, Sales Compensation Strategy and Operations
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is looking for an Associate to support how we run and scale compensation for our sales organization.

You'll work closely with the Sales Compensation Strategy & Operations Manager and partner with the Commissions and Territory teams from day one. You'll own opportunity credit adjustments, applying sales policy and rules of engagement to get crediting right, and you'll own quarterly MBO consolidation and reporting. Reps rely on getting paid accurately, so precision and judgment matter here.

This role also has a builder side. Much of sales compensation work is still manual and reactive. You'll help redesign it into scalable, proactive processes using AI tools and automation. As you grow, you'll take on more analytical work: attainment reporting, quota analysis, and the insights Sales leaders use to make compensation decisions.

About the GTM Strategy & Operations Team

We’re a small, collaborative team that sits at the intersection of data, sales strategy, and go-to-market systems. Our work shapes how Toast’s sales org is structured, how territories and quotas are set, and how reps are paid. We move fast, stay close to the business, and take pride in building things that actually get used.

 

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

Sales Compensation Operations

• Manage a high volume of opportunity credit adjustments, applying sales policy and rules of engagement (ROE) to get crediting right, and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation

• Process recurring data loads throughout the month

• Lead quarterly MBO (management by objectives) consolidation and reporting for sales managers, from collecting inputs to delivering final results

• Be a trusted point of contact for sales leaders and reps on crediting questions, explaining decisions clearly and consistently

Process Scalability & AI Enablement

• Design, build, and test AI-assisted workflows and automations, such as data cleanup and recurring reports, that cut manual effort on your projects

• Help shift sales compensation from reactive to proactive by building automated checks and alerts that surface issues early

• Write and maintain SOPs and sales comp policy documentation so processes are consistent, auditable, and not dependent on any one person

• Spot repetitive work across the team and propose better ways to do it

Planning & Analysis

• Support monthly attainment reporting and leadership-facing decks

• Help scale and elevate compensation reporting by standardizing recurring reports, improving dashboards, and automating manual refreshes

• Support plan design and quota analysis, such as modeling scenarios and pulling data for Sales leadership recommendations

• Partner with the Territory team to support the rollout of territory-based quotas, including data preparation, validation, and rep-level quota reporting

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 0-2 years of experience in an analytical or operations role, such as sales ops, revenue ops, finance, payroll, business operations, or consulting

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets

• High attention to detail, with ownership of accuracy when deadlines are tight

• Curiosity about AI tools and a habit of looking for a better way to do repetitive work

• Clear written and verbal communication

• A bias toward action and comfort with a fast-moving, high-volume environment

• Experience with Salesforce (CRM) or similar systems or willing to learn quickly

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

title: Data Analyst
description:

Everglade Works is a tech company focused on driving innovation through data, automation, and cloud technologies. We are a tech-first, remote-first company, and we want you to help us take data analysis to the next level.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our growing team and play a pivotal role in analyzing complex datasets, optimizing data-driven processes, and providing insightful recommendations to leadership. This is a unique opportunity to make a direct impact on business strategy by extracting, analyzing, and presenting key data that supports our operational and growth goals.
As a Data Analyst at Everglade Works , you will work cross-functionally with departments like Operations, Marketing, and Engineering, using your skills to interpret data trends, visualize insights, and drive smarter decision-making.
What You'll Be Doing

• Analyze large datasets from a variety of sources (internal tools, external databases, APIs, etc.) to uncover patterns, trends, and insights

• Have 2+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or similar role

You will sit at the intersection of empathetic service, AI analytics, and business strategy. You will design and own an enterprise-grade Closed-Loop Root Cause Intelligence Engine . Your mission is twofold: decode why travelers cancel in real time to ensure Service Operations provide effortless support and translate real-time cancellation reasons into high-impact business insights that drive executive decision-making, revenue protection, policy adjustments, and product innovation.   At Tripadvisor Group we are Traveler first in all our decision making.

Provide feedback to Service Operations for Process optimisation and People Coaching opportunities

•
Maintain a dynamic "Friction-to-Fix" Tracker that quantifies the financial and sentiment impact of unresolved root causes and holds cross-functional owners accountable for operational resolutions.

•
Design and deploy AI-driven conversational intelligence models (LLM/NLP) that prioritize identifying traveler distress, confusion, and intent across voice, chat, messaging, and email.

Integrate generative AI speech-to-text, sentiment scoring, and intent recognition tools directly into front-line agent platforms to support teams in delivering empathetic care.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl just launched  Cribl Detect , our SIEM built on the Cribl platform. Detection and response is the foundation. Your job is to figure out what comes next - and then build it.

• Spend real time with customers - CISOs, SOC managers, detection engineers, and analysts - and work with design partners to validate direction before we commit.

• Partner with Marketing, Sales, and technology partners on positioning, packaging, launch, and field enablement.

• Grow the team - as areas get funded, hire and lead product managers to own them.

• Represent Cribl security externally with customers, analysts, and at industry events.

• We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.

• 10+ years in product management or a closely related role, with 5+ years building security products.

• Deep understanding of security operations - SIEM, detection engineering, incident response, and how SOC teams actually work day to day.

• Hands-on product experience in at least one of: security automation and response (SOAR), identity security (ITDR, UEBA), AI or agentic security, or threat detection and response.

• A track record of taking a product from 0 to 1 - from problem discovery to a product customers pay for and use.

• Portfolio-level thinking - you have evaluated new markets, built business cases, and made clear recommendations with incomplete information.

• Leadership - experience leading or mentoring PMs, and leading through influence across engineering, marketing, and sales.

• Technical depth to go deep with engineers on data architectures, detection logic, and AI/LLM-based systems.

• Strong written communication - you write clear strategy docs and PRDs, and you make decisions in writing.

This person will design resilient audio systems, serve as A1 when failures are immediately visible, and deliver exceptional spoken-word audio across live, recorded, remote, and AI-enabled production workflows.

- Expert command of gain structure, routing, EQ, dynamics, automixing, feedback control, real time noise suppression, mix-minus, IFB, intercom, playback, comms, and latency management.

- Deep experience designing and troubleshooting redundant program, stream, multitrack, camera, backup-recorder, and archival audio paths.

- Advanced proficiency with networked audio and DSP systems such as Dante, AVB, SMPTE ST 2110, Q-SYS, Yamaha, and Shure.

- Strong IP-networking knowledge, including clocking, multicast, VLANs, QoS, and diagnosing failures across audio, control, and enterprise IT environments.

- Ability to mix full-duplex speech-to-speech audio between humans and AI models for a variety of different event formats

- Fluency with broadcast encoders, embedded audio, streaming protocols, conferencing platforms, and external distribution endpoints.

- Expert-level understanding of room acoustics and a fundamental understanding of acoustic science.

- Demonstrated success diagnosing and repairing signal-chain, DSP, synchronization, routing, RF, networking, and hardware faults during live production.

- Strong multitrack recording,

title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Research Scientist, Visual Reasoning
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Research and develop novel visual and spatio-temporal reasoning methods for multimodal Perception Foundation Models using AV sensor data

• Design and implement post-training recipes-including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL)-to improve perception generalization in long-tail autonomous driving scenarios

• Conduct large-scale experiments and ablation studies on autonomous driving benchmarks, with the opportunity to publish findings at top-tier AI/CV conferences (e.g., CVPR/ICCV/ECCV/NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML)

 

You have:

• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field

• Hands-on experience & strong publications in perception, and/or LLM/VLM

• Knowledge of pre-training and post-training of the large foundation models

• Strong Python coding skills with expertise in modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)

 

We prefer:

• Experience with visual reasoning for LLM/VLM/robotics/driving

• Experience with RL training in LLM/VLM/robotics

• Experience with open-vocabulary perception

 

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.
The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements.

Hourly PhD Pay
$85 — $85 USD

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Map & Route Team

Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products.

- Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data.

- Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale.

- Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation.

- Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps.

- Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs.

- Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like.

- Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next.

- Map data preparation for model training and simulation.

- New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace.

- You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review).

- You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark.

- You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets.

- You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services.

- You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end.

- Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage.

- Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory.

- Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. title: Werkstudent Industrialisatie Engineering PCBA
description: Als Werkstudent Industrialisatie Engineering PCBA ondersteun je onze Industrialisatie Engineers bij het introduceren van nieuwe producten. Je helpt bij praktische en administratieve werkzaamheden, zodat producten goed voorbereid de productie in gaan. Jij brengt bij ons in de praktijk wat je tijdens je studie leert! Spreken we je snel? Jij draagt bij aan het voorbereiden, vastleggen en verbeteren van productieprocessen door onder andere werkinstructies op te stellen, technische documentatie te beheren en product- en procesgegevens te verwerken. Daarnaast ondersteun je tijdens de eerste productiebouw, controleer je onderdelen en documentatie en help je bij het voorbereiden van bedrading, tooling en werkplekken. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt in een multifunctioneel klantenteam, waarbij je een of meerdere Industrialisatie Engineers ondersteunt bij de introductie van nieuwe producten (NPI). Je stelt WPI’s op aan de hand van de door de Industrialisatie Engineers aangeleverde bouwvolgorde. Je ondersteunt bij het importeren en verwerken van klantdata, zodat deze geschikt is voor vastlegging in onze eigen systemen. Je ondersteunt bij het productiegereed maken van proto-orders. Je levert ondersteuning tijdens protobouw, verzamelt de feedback van operators en stemt die af met de Industrialisatie Engineer alvorens deze te verwerken in de WPI’s. Je levert input voor het proto evaluatierapport aan de Industrialisatie Engineer.

Data Governance Analyst
Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.
GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Data Governance Analyst will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.
The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's data governance framework so that data is managed and protected as a strategic enterprise asset and to accelerate CMM modernization efforts. This role acts as a Data Standards Architect, defining and documenting data standards, definitions, and structures across systems, and works closely with legal, compliance, security, and business stakeholders to ensure data is handled in accordance with privacy, security, retention, classification, and regulatory requirements. This role also ensures alignment with Judiciary policies, practices, and the current Data Governance Roadmap, and fosters a data driven culture across the AO and local courts.
The Data Governance Analyst will execute the following responsibilities:

• Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the CMM Data Governance framework, policies, standards, procedures, and operating models.

• Serve as a Data Standards Architect, define, document, and maintain data standards, naming conventions, data definitions, data structures, reference data, and governance requirements.

• Develop and maintain data governance standards aligned with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, records management, and regulatory requirements.

• Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models.

• Partner with Data Stewards, Data Owners, business stakeholders, security, privacy, legal, records management, and technology teams to operationalize governance requirements.

• Ensure data assets are appropriately classified and managed based on sensitivity, criticality, and business value.

• Support compliance with data privacy, security, retention, classification, records management, and regulatory requirements.

• Translate policies and regulatory requirements into actionable data governance controls and procedures.

• Identify governance gaps, risks, and areas of non-compliance and coordinate remediation activities.

• Support data access, sharing, usage, and lifecycle governance processes.

• Participate in governance councils, working groups, and data domain forums.

• Develop governance documentation, standards, procedures, decision logs, and supporting artifacts.

• Monitor adoption and effectiveness of governance policies and standards.

• Support governance-related assessments, audits, and compliance reviews.

• Contribute to the development of data governance roadmaps, maturity assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Support the data stewardship program by defining data ownership roles, responsibilities, and RACI models across business and technical teams.

title: Brand Marketing Lead
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Brand & Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help own our brand marketing strategy and campaign execution across six European markets and be part of our marketing team as we scale our spend management platform. If you're excited about building category-defining campaigns that move Pleo from a good solution to the undisputed choice for mid-market finance leaders and are passionate about brand strategy and creative execution, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to the Director of Integrated Marketing, and work in close collaboration with the Director of Brand Experience and Strategy, as well as the Brand Intelligence Manager, our brand foundations team, PR, content marketing and digital channels team. You’ll partner cross-functionally with PMM, MOPS, CX and sales. This is a hands-on, IC role, where you'll do both the thinking and the work-strategy and execution both sit with you.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Brand Marketing Lead, you will:

- Own the brand marketing strategy that moves Pleo from ‘one of many’ to the undisputed choice for mid-market European finance leaders.

- Build and execute integrated brand campaigns from concept through to reporting - learning from what we’ve just launched, and pushing further.

- Create branded content that shows how financial services should be done. Content that recognizes the precision, rigor, and craft that finance leaders bring to their work.

- Manage the funnel strategically - balancing awareness, consideration, and conversion. Not just fishing in the pond of people who already know us, but earning the right to speak to people we don’t know yet.

- Own your budget and agency relationships - you’re the strategic partner they answer to.

- Measure what matters - working with Brand Intelligence, Integrated Marketing, Data, and MOps to track brand lift, earned media, consideration, and how brand work flows into pipeline and revenue.

- Set the benchmark for brand work in fintech - prove that category-defining campaigns come from strategic rigor and creative excellence working together. You’ll establish Pleo as the model for how brands should think about their audience, and show that understanding someone better than anyone else is a more powerful differentiator than any feature.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- 10+ years in brand marketing (B2B or fintech might be helpful, but we care more about the thinking than the category)

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Full-Time | Remote (Europe / CET-Compatible Time Zones)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based, independent video game development company focused on building unforgettable, player-first experiences driven by clear artistic direction, state-of-the-art tools and a strong visual identity. Our work is guided by a culture of innovation, creativity and close collaboration, allowing us to pursue our vision of bringing back the fun in video games and creating experiences that feel engaging, rewarding and memorable for players. We operate as a fully remote studio with a globally distributed team of experienced developers, artists and designers. Prism is structured around trust, accountability and clear communication, enabling us to collaborate efficiently across time zones while maintaining a consistent standard of quality and execution.

The studio is currently developing its first PvPvE multiplayer showdown shooter, Heptic Arena, with the aim of standing out within the genre and leaving a lasting impression on players. Join us on our exciting journey as we continue to build cutting-edge games, push the boundaries of what’s possible in the gaming world, and provide unparalleled entertainment and compelling experiences for players around the globe!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to play a hands-on role in maintaining and raising the quality of our games throughout development.

Working closely with engineering, design, art and production, you will help apply a structured and proactive approach to testing across game features. You will be responsible for creating detailed test plans, identifying and investigating complex issues, executing testing workflows, and ensuring problems are communicated clearly and resolved effectively.

This role goes beyond surface-level testing. We are looking for someone who understands game development from a technical perspective and can think critically about how systems interact, where they may fail, and how quality can be verified early in the development process. As we develop Heptic Arena, you will play an important role in ensuring that gameplay systems, multiplayer functionality, performance, and the overall player experience meet the standard we want to deliver.

What You’ll Do

• Define and execute test coverage across features, systems, and game builds throughout development.

• Create detailed test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical and gameplay requirements.

• Test new features and systems across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility scenarios.

• Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and relevant technical information.

• Work directly with engineers, designers, and other disciplines to investigate issues, determine severity, and validate fixes.

• Test gameplay systems within Unreal Engine 5, using your technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behaviour.

• Support testing of multiplayer and networked gameplay, identifying issues relating to replication, connectivity, latency, synchronisation, and player interactions.

• Coordinate and support internal playtests, turning observations and player feedback into clear, actionable findings.

• Maintain bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and reporting within Jira.

• Monitor defect trends and testing data to identify recurring issues and areas requiring additional test coverage.

• Contribute to automated testing and internal QA tools where appropriate.

• Work closely with production and QA leadership to prioritise defects against development milestones and release requirements.

• Help the wider team identify technical and gameplay risks early rather than relying on testing at the very end of production.

About You

• Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a senior QA, QA Engineer,

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own our monitoring and alerting in Datadog . You’ll make sure we know when something is wrong, that the right people hear about it quickly, and that the issues behind the alerts get fixed. You’ll also work with client´s InfoSec team to align on any configuration needed.

• Define, measure, and report on service level indicators and objectives for key customer-facing services.

title: (Senior) Operational Risk Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Risk Controlling team shapes Raisin Group’s resilience by establishing and maintaining the group-wide risk management framework in line with regulatory standards such as Basel. The team defines risk policies and controls and is responsible for identifying and assessing material risks across the group, including operational, credit, market, and liquidity risk, using methods such as risk assessments, stress testing, and scenario analysis.

In addition, Risk Controlling continuously monitors the group’s risk profile through risk metrics, key risk indicators, and early warning signals. The team prepares risk reporting for senior management and regulatory authorities and supports capital and liquidity adequacy assessments in line with regulatory requirements, ensuring the business model is backed by appropriate risk-bearing capacity and liquidity strength
